d: Platinum white hair, short and swept back from the forehead, paired with sharp, amber-colored eyes and a mature, stern facial expression. A muscular build encased in heavy, dark brown and gold plate armor with a high collar and large pauldrons, complemented by a sweeping, orange-gold tattered cape. Notable features include a pair of large, orange leathery wings emerging from the head and a massive, ornate dark brown shield with a glowing golden sun emblem. BODY COLOR: Dark brown LEGS: Plantigrade, encased in heavy armored boots.
